# Best Tensile Structure Pvt. Ltd.

> Best Tensile Structure Pvt. Ltd. is a premier manufacturer and supplier of modern architectural tensile structures, car parking shades, walkway structures, gazebos, tensile fabric canopies, and custom membrane solutions based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## Overview

- **Company Name**: Best Tensile Structure Pvt. Ltd.
- **Tagline**: Top Tensile Structure Manufacturers in Udaipur
- **Experience**: 16+ Years in Tensile Architectural Engineering & Design
- **Location**: 2nd Floor, Madaar Plaza, Thokar Chouraha Ayad Road, Udaipur – 313001, Rajasthan, India
- **Contact**: +91-988-788-9777 | +91-905-791-1777 | info@besttensilestructure.com
- **Website Repository**: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure)

## Technical Architecture & Tech Stack

This project is a high-performance single-page web application built with a modern frontend tech stack:

- **Framework**: React 19 + TypeScript 6.0
- **Build Tool**: Vite 8.1
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + PostCSS
- **Animations & Effects**: Framer Motion, Swiper (Carousels), React CountUp
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Routing**: React Router v7 (with HTML fallback routes like `/about-us.htm`, `/contact-us.htm` for legacy SEO compatibility)
- **SEO & Meta**: React Helmet Async + Dynamic Open Graph Meta Tags
- **Linter**: Oxlint

## Main Website Pages & Routes

- [Home Page](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/HomePage.tsx): Main landing showcase featuring hero sliders, featured products, company stats, and interactive CTA.
- [About Us](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx): Mission, vision, core values, 16+ years history, and manufacturing capabilities.
- [Products Catalog](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx): Complete product listing across categories (Parking Shades, Walkway Canopies, Gazebos, PTFE Membranes, Luxury Tents).
- [Product Detail Page](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx): Dynamic route (`/:slug`) rendering product specifications, applications, key features, and instant inquiry forms.
- [Project Gallery](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx): Showcase of completed installations and engineering projects.
- [Blog & Articles](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/BlogsPage.tsx): Architectural guides, maintenance tips, and commercial real estate insights.
- [Contact & Inquiry](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx): Direct contact forms, phone numbers, email details, and embedded Google Maps.
- [Sitemap](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx): Comprehensive site navigation map.

## Product Portfolio & Architectural Solutions

The application details 31 specialized architectural tensile product lines defined in [websiteData.ts](https://github.com/Eshbanoliver/tensile-structure/blob/main/src/data/websiteData.ts):

1. **Car Parking Tensile Structure**: UV-resistant and weather-hardened vehicle parking shades for commercial & residential complexes.
2. **Walkway Tensile Structure**: Covered pedestrian shade corridors for hospitals, universities, and corporate parks.
3. **Garden Tensile Umbrella**: Heavy-duty architectural shade parasols for outdoor lawns, cafes, and resorts.
4. **Tensile Fabric Structure**: Column-free wide-span PVDF/PTFE architectural fabric solutions.
5. **Tensile Membrane Structure**: Weather-resistant membrane systems for public venues and auditoriums.
6. **PTFE Tensile Membrane Structure**: Ultra-durable fluoropolymer coated glass-fiber membranes with 30+ year lifespan.
7. **Gazebo Tensile Structure**: High-peak outdoor pavilion structures for resorts and event lawns.
8. **Industrial Tensile Shed**: Rapid-deploy wide-span fabric sheds for warehouses and factories.
9. **Terrace Tensile Shed**: Rooftop transformation shades for outdoor lounges, dining, and cafes.
10. **Tensile Pagoda Tent**: High-peak modular tents for VIP events and luxury hospitality.
11. **Entrance Tensile Structure**: Architectural entry canopies for hotels and corporate office entrances.
12. **Stadium Tensile Structure**: Turnkey wide-span cable-tensioned stadium roof covers.
13. **Swimming Pool Tensile Cover**: UV-blocking pool shades for resorts and athletic clubs.
14. **Royal Resort Tent House**: Insulated luxury glamping tent structures for eco-resorts.
15. **Reverse & Inverted Umbrella Structures**: Conical tensile shades designed with integrated rainwater harvesting.

## Codebase Directory Structure

```
tensile/
├── public/                 # Static public assets (images, icons, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llm.txt)
├── src/
│   ├── assets/             # SVGs, project logos, images
│   ├── components/         # Reusable UI components (Header, Footer, Navbar, Cards, Modals, ErrorBoundary)
│   ├── data/               # Centralized data model (websiteData.ts)
│   ├── layouts/            # MainLayout wrapper
│   ├── pages/              # Page views (HomePage, ProductsPage, ProductDetailPage, etc.)
│   ├── sections/           # Modular page sections (Hero, FeaturedProducts, Stats, Testimonials, FAQ)
│   ├── App.tsx             # React Router v7 configuration & lazy loading setup
│   ├── main.tsx            # Entry mounting point
│   └── index.css           # Tailwind v4 directives & custom CSS utilities
├── llm.txt                 # Structured documentation for LLMs & AI assistants
├── index.html              # HTML shell & font definitions
├── package.json            # Project dependencies and script declarations
├── vite.config.ts          # Vite bundler configuration
└── tsconfig.json           # TypeScript configuration
```

## Development & Operations Commands

- `npm run dev`: Start local development server on `http://localhost:5173`.
- `npm run build`: Compile TypeScript and bundle production build output into `dist/`.
- `npm run preview`: Serve production build locally for verification.
- `npm run lint`: Execute Oxlint to check code quality and syntax integrity.
